description: An employee expense report is pending in the system and blocking the monthly close process. Log into Odoo (admin@example.com / admin, database: odoo_demo) and process the expense report for employee Sarah Mitchell. The report titled 'Q1 Client Visit - Chicago' was submitted and is awaiting approval. Your tasks: (1) Navigate to the Expenses module and locate Sarah Mitchell's submitted expense report. (2) Review the expense items and approve the report as manager. (3) Post the accounting journal entries for the approved report. (4) Register the reimbursement payment to the employee.
